courses.h2: With us, everyone has a place.
courses.lede: We teach English to all ages, from 6 upwards.

items.title: Primary
items.desc: We guide younger learners from the very first stage, introducing reading and writing gradually and helping them see English as a real, useful tool.

items.title: Teens
items.desc: Grammar, vocabulary and Use of English worked systematically, driving progress in all four language skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking).

items.title: Adults
items.desc: The same structured method, adapted to an adult's pace and needs. Solid grammar and vocabulary foundations, always encouraging learners to lose their fear of holding conversations in English.

items.title: Cambridge Exams
items.desc:
AUTHORISED CAMBRIDGE EXAM PREPARATION CENTRE SINCE 2005.

Every student is placed in a group according to their overall ability level on the Common European Framework of Reference.

Those who wish to can certify their level of English, with full preparation using authentic materials.

We prepare Young Learners (Starters, Movers, Flyers), A2 (Key English Test), B1 (Preliminary English Test), B2 (First Certificate) and C1 (Advanced).

items.title: Summer courses
items.desc: Intensive official exam preparation courses. Maintenance courses. Conversation classes. Tailored private lessons.

exams.lede: Our students don't just study English, they certify it. We prepare each level in full and enter candidates for the official examination as an authorised Cambridge English centre.

rungs.name: Key (KET)
rungs.desc: The first official certificate. Proves a solid grasp of everyday written and spoken English.

rungs.name: Preliminary (PET)
rungs.desc: Independent user level. Required by many secondary schools and increasingly by universities.

rungs.name: First (FCE)
rungs.desc: The most requested certificate in Spain. Standard requirement for degree programmes and most job applications.

rungs.name: Advanced (CAE)
rungs.desc: Proficient user. Opens doors to postgraduate study, international universities and professional roles abroad.

exams.yleNote: The Young Learners series, designed so children build the same foundations from age 7, without pressure.

method.h2:
A method that has
been proven for
over twenty years.
method.lede: We follow a structured progression, the same one the Cambridge teaching blocks use. Nothing is skipped, nothing is improvised.

pillars.title: All five areas, every unit
pillars.text: Reading, writing, listening, speaking and use of English. Grammar and vocabulary worked properly, not left to chance.

pillars.title: You move up when you're ready
pillars.text: Nobody advances just because the course ended. You move up when all five areas are there, and the teacher decides that with the work in front of them.

pillars.title: Teachers who stay
pillars.text: Qualified, experienced and here year after year. Your child will not get a different teacher every term.

reviews.h2: Don't take our word for it.

items.name: Marta S.
items.quote: My daughter has been going for four years. She went through Movers and Flyers and passed B1 Preliminary first time. The progression is clear and you can see it term by term.

items.name: Jordi R.
items.quote: What convinced me was the structure. There's a syllabus, there's homework, there's correction. After two years I passed B2 First, and I actually understood why I passed.

items.name: Anna P.
items.quote: What I value most is that they know my son. They noticed he was struggling with reading before we did, and they adapted. You don't get that in a big academy.

contact.lede: Bring your child, or come yourself. One class, no commitment, no pressure, just so you can see how we work before deciding anything.
